name: Scroll Map
author: jgarza
description: Mini-map of this monitor's active-workspace windows for the Hyprland scrolling layout. Each window is a bracketed glyph at full bar height - padding grows continuously with its size ([x] .. [  x  ], floating windows in parentheses) and colour shows where it is: accent when focused, foreground on screen, muted when scrolled off. Pick from focus animations (bracket snap, slide cursor, breathe, pop, hypr-pop, glitch, neon) plus unfold/collapse and float-lift.

barWidget.description: Bracketed-glyph mini-map of the scrolling-layout windows on the active workspace.

schema.label: Label
schema.description: What sits inside each window's brackets.

options.label: App icons
options.description: The application icon at full bar height, first class letter when none resolves.

options.label: Nerd Font glyphs
options.description: A Nerd Font glyph matched from the window class, a generic window glyph when unmatched.

options.label: Short name
options.description: The window class cut to a few characters.

options.label: Brackets only
options.description: Empty brackets - size and colour carry all the information.

schema.label: Short-name length
schema.description: Characters shown per window in short-name mode. Ignored by the other label modes.

schema.label: Focus animation
schema.description: Played on a window when it gains focus.

options.label: Bracket snap
options.description: The brackets fly in from wide and clamp onto the glyph with a little overshoot.

options.label: Slide cursor
options.description: An accent underline glides from the old focused window to the new one.

options.label: Breathe
options.description: The brackets pulse outward a few times, calm and heartbeat-like, then settle.

options.label: Pop
options.description: The glyph scales up briefly and springs back.

options.label: Hypr-pop
options.description: A big multi-stage bounce with a rotation wobble and a shockwave ring - deliberately over the top.

options.label: Glitch
options.description: Rapid position jitter, an accent flash and a cyan/magenta chromatic fringe on the brackets.

options.label: Neon
options.description: Brackets and glyph flicker through brightness variations of the theme accent, like a tube lighting up.

schema.label: Unfold / collapse
schema.description: When an app opens, its window unfolds out of ][ into its brackets; when it closes, the window folds back and fades out. Switching workspaces doesn't trigger it.

schema.label: Float lift
schema.description: Toggling floating hops the window while [ ] morphs into ( ).

schema.label: Include floating windows
schema.description: Slot floating windows in by position, drawn with ( ) instead of [ ]. Off by default since the scrolling layout only tiles.

schema.label: Maximum strip width
schema.description: Longest the mini-map may get, in logical pixels (height on a vertical bar). Padding shrinks first; past that the strip clips and follows focus.

schema.label: Padding range
schema.description: Padding per side, in logical px, for a window as big as the monitor. Smaller windows get proportionally less, so every resize nudges the brackets. Higher values make size differences more visible.

schema.label: Size curve
schema.description: How padding grows with window size, in tenths: padding = size ^ (value / 10). 10 is linear; higher values give big windows disproportionately more padding so they stand out, while small windows stay compact.

schema.label: Gap between windows
schema.description: Space between bracketed windows in logical pixels.
